'''Changu''' was a guard in [[Shienar]].

==Appearance==
Changu was squat and stocky.

==History==
Changu was at [[Tarwin's Gap]] and fought to save [[Lord]] [[Agelmar Jagad]]. 

== Activities ==
He was in charge of the [[Darkfriend]], [[Padan Fain]] during Fain's imprisonment at Fal Dara. Fain corrupts Changu and [[Nidao]] and they help him escape from his prison cell. Changu and [[Nidao]] travel with the group led by [[Padan Fain]] towards [[Toman Head]] until both were skinned alive by [[Padan Fain|Padan Fain's]] orders and died to their wounds. Their skinned bodies were found by [[Ragan]] hanging from a stone oak on the far side of the river Erinnin. He was given the last embrace of the mother on the order's of [[Ingtar Shinowa|Ingtar]]
